summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Quick 86 / Sold-Out feature. 20/20 backend pytest cases passed (auth guard, settings, toggle, batch, log, menu regression, auto-restore on fresh day). Frontend Playwright: 11/11 steps passed — admin-86 page, search/filter, per-item toggle, batch 86+restore, category batch row, log table (31 rows), auto-restore switch, sidebar link, and quick-86 button on Live Queue OrderCards (2 buttons found on active orders, click succeeded). Auto-restore correctly fires once per fresh day and does not re-fire on repeated /store/status calls. Cleanup executed; all items restored to in_stock.
critical_code_review_comments: sidebar data-testid 'admin-nav-86 / sold-out' contains spaces and slashes — works but brittle. Consider normalizing to a slug like 'admin-nav-86-sold-out' for cleaner selectors.
Quick-86 button is hover-only (opacity-0 group-hover/item:opacity-100). Accessible users and touch devices may struggle to discover it. Consider a visible ghost state on mobile/touch.
maybe_auto_restore wraps no try/except around per-item updates; a single failing update would stop the loop. Minor — low risk.
_maybe_trigger_auto_restore swallows all exceptions silently. Prefer logging at warning level so failures are observable.

/api/admin/86/batch de-duplicates via set(item_ids + category-items) — good. However result 'updated' counts items that had no status change (all pass through _set_item_status). Currently _set_item_status skips logging if prev==new, but still counts as updated. Acceptable but could be tightened to only count real changes.
Pre-existing (not in this change-set): admin login redirects to '/' instead of '/admin'. Not caused by this PR; noting for awareness.
seed_data_creation: No new seed created. Used existing menu items item-001..item-010. All items restored to in_stock at teardown (verified by batch-restore-all at end of FE run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Quick 86 feature fully functional on both BE + FE. Backend pytest file /app/backend/tests/test_eightysix.py is idempotent (has module-scope cleanup fixture). Auto-restore test uses pymongo directly to reset last_auto_restore_date — requires MONGO_URL env. If store is not open in the preview env, that test auto-skips. All new data-testid selectors match spec exactly.
